instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by

theorem req_effects         : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_idempotency     : Idempotent step := sorry
theorem req_last_admin      : KeepsAdmin step := sorry

theorem req_idempotency     : Idempotent step := by
  intro s r hok
  by_cases hvc : ValidCommand s r
  · have hs : step s r = (.ok, ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State)) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hvc]
    rw [hs]
    -- need to show step s' r = (rejected, s')
    suffices hnov : ¬ ValidCommand ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) r by
      have hstep : step ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) r =
        (.rejected, ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State)) := by
        unfold step
        simp [hnov]
      exact hstep
    -- prove invalid
    intro hvc2
    obtain ⟨hactor_mem, htarget_mem, hactor_admin, hgrant, hrevoke⟩ := hvc
    obtain ⟨hactor_mem2, htarget_mem2, hactor_admin2, hgrant2, hrevoke2⟩ := hvc2
    -- analyze op
    cases hop : r.op with
    | grant =>
      have hg := hgrant rfl
      have hg2 := hgrant2 rfl
      -- hg : actor ≠ target ∧ has target role = false
      -- hg2 : actor ≠ target ∧ has' target role = false, but has' = true
      have hhas : (expectedHas s r r.target r.role) = true := by
        unfold expectedHas
        simp [hop]
      -- hgrant2 needs has' = false
      have : ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State).has r.target r.role = false := hg2.2
      simp at this
      rw [hhas] at this
      simp at this
    | revoke =>
      have hr := hrevoke rfl
      have hr2 := hrevoke2 rfl
      have hhas : (expectedHas s r r.target r.role) = false := by
        unfold expectedHas
        simp [hop]
      have : ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State).has r.target r.role = true := hr2.1
      simp at this
      rw [hhas] at this
      simp at this
  · unfold step at hok
    simp [hvc] at hok

theorem req_last_admin : KeepsAdmin step := by
  intro s r hex
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0mem, hu0admin⟩ := hex
  by_cases hvc : ValidCommand s r
  · have hs : step s r = (.ok, ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State)) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hvc]
    -- need to produce witness depending on op
    obtain ⟨hactor_mem, htarget_mem, hactor_admin, hgrant, hrevoke⟩ := hvc
    cases hop : r.op with
    | grant =>
      -- actor remains admin because actor ≠ target
      have hne : r.actor ≠ r.target := (hgrant hop).1
      refine ⟨r.actor, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : (step s r).2.users = s.users := by rw [hs]; rfl
        rw [this]; exact hactor_mem
      · have hhas : (step s r).2.has r.actor .admin = true := by
          rw [hs]
          show expectedHas s r r.actor .admin = true
          unfold expectedHas
          have hneg : ¬ (r.actor = r.target ∧ (Role.admin = r.role)) := by
            intro h2
            exact hne h2.1
          simp [hneg, hactor_admin]
        exact hhas
    | revoke =>
      by_cases hrole : r.role = .admin
      · -- use OtherAdmin witness
        have hrev := hrevoke hop
        have hother : OtherAdmin s r.target := hrev.2 hrole
        unfold OtherAdmin at hother
        obtain ⟨v, hvmem, hvne, hvadmin⟩ := hother
        refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have : (step s r).2.users = s.users := by rw [hs]; rfl
          rw [this]; exact hvmem
        · have hhas : (step s r).2.has v .admin = true := by
            rw [hs]
            show expectedHas s r v .admin = true
            unfold expectedHas
            have hneg : ¬ (v = r.target ∧ (Role.admin = r.role)) := by
              intro h2
              apply hvne
              rw [h2.1]
              -- need v = target? h2.1 : v = r.target, so v = target gives? hvne : v ≠ r.target
              -- hvne expects v ≠ r.target, h2.1 gives equality, contradiction
              exact h2.1
              -- Actually hvne : v ≠ r.target, so apply to h2.1
            -- need to massage: q = r.role with q=.admin, r.role=.admin via hrole
            have hneg2 : ¬ (v = r.target ∧ .admin = r.role) := by
              rw [hrole] at *
              exact hneg
            -- expectedHas uses q = r.role, i.e. .admin = r.role
            simp [hneg2, hvadmin]
        exact hhas
      · -- original admin persists
        refine ⟨u0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have : (step s r).2.users = s.users := by rw [hs]; rfl
          rw [this]; exact hu0mem
        · have hhas : (step s r).2.has u0 .admin = true := by
            rw [hs]
            show expectedHas s r u0 .admin = true
            unfold expectedHas
            have hneg : ¬ (u0 = r.target ∧ (Role.admin = r.role)) := by
              intro h2
              exact hrole h2.2.symm
            simp [hneg, hu0admin]
          exact hhas
  · have hs : step s r = (.rejected, s) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hvc]
    refine ⟨u0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : (step s r).2 = s := by rw [hs]; rfl
      rw [this]; exact hu0mem
    · have : (step s r).2 = s := by rw [hs]; rfl
      rw [this]; exact hu0admin
